description: The routine reads decimal digits from a text pointer into a number and, when that number is nonzero, checks the following text against a fixed length. It then calls two follow-up routines and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:0978
name: parse_decimal_number_from_text
description: The routine accumulates decimal digits from a text pointer until a non-digit is reached, then checks the following text when the number is nonzero. It calls two follow-up routines and returns with no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:5:09EE
name: convert_char_to_digit

name: return_zero_no_effect

name: return_without_action

description: The routine passes three arguments to a different library function than its sibling and returns the fourth argument when the result matches it, and zero otherwise.

name: skip_without_effect

description: The routine divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor. It uses a sixteen-step shift-and-subtract loop when the divisor is above the 16-bit range and split 16-bit divisions otherwise, and returns the quotient and remainder as a pair.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:8:0020
name: run_sixteen_step_division
description: The routine runs the sixteen-step shift-and-subtract loop of a division on a 32-bit value, subtracting the divisor from the high half whenever it fits. It leaves the partial result in registers and returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:8:0040
name: multiply_32bit_values
description: The routine multiplies two 32-bit register values using 16-bit partial products and returns the low 32 bits of the product. It also returns the second operand with its two halves swapped.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:8:00C8
name: call_formatted_output_library
description: The routine calls a library entry at a fixed negative offset from the global library base and returns. The entry is the formatted-text routine of the Amiga operating system, so this is a thin wrapper around formatted output.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:7:0000

name: find_char_in_string
description: The routine scans a null-terminated string for a given byte value and returns a pointer to its first match, or zero if the terminator is reached first.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:7:0026
name: return_zero_quietly

name: copy_c_string
description: The routine copies bytes from the source string to the destination, including the terminating zero byte, and stops after writing that byte. It returns no value.

name: append_c_string
description: The routine moves to the terminator of the destination string and then copies the source string, including its zero byte, after it. It returns no value.

name: compare_strings_up_to_count
description: The routine compares two byte strings for up to the given count. It returns one when a byte differs within that count and zero when the strings match through the count or at the terminator.

name: return_one_constant

description: The routine steps through a null-terminated string for at most the given number of characters. If it reaches the terminator it calls a follow-up routine before returning, and otherwise it returns with no value.

name: forward_to_follow_up_call
description: The routine calls another routine with no arguments and then returns, passing its work on.

name: copy_string_with_zero_padding
description: The routine copies a source string into a fixed-size destination up to the given byte count, stopping after the terminator. If the copy finished before the count ran out, it fills the rest of the destination with zero bytes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:10:0000
name: initialize_list_header
description: The routine stores a pointer to itself, offset by four, in the first longword of a block, clears the next longword, and stores its own address in the following longword. This sets up a self-referencing structure like an empty list head.

name: validate_record_then_apply_field
description: If the record pointer is null, the routine returns one. Otherwise it runs a check with a fixed type value and, on success, calls a follow-up routine and then a second routine using a field of the record; it returns zero when the check fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:3:0082

description: The routine walks a linked list of records through the link at a fixed offset. For each record it performs a library step and then a second step on a pointer field, scaled by a count byte, and returns one when the list ends or zero if any step fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:3:00E2
name: return_one_without_work
description: The routine returns one and performs no other work.

name: return_zero_trivially
description: The routine returns zero and does nothing else.

name: allocate_record_when_requested
description: When the count argument is nonzero, the routine allocates a 20-byte block and runs two library steps on it, storing a resulting pointer at a fixed offset and making a final call. It returns the block on success, minus one on failure, and zero when the count is zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:3:01BC
name: return_minus_one_constant
description: The routine returns minus one with no other effect.

description: The routine links a series of 16-byte records into a chain, running library steps on each one and storing a size field and a pointer field along the way. It returns the first record of the chain, zero for an empty request, or minus one if any step fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:Icon.Library:3:020E
name: step_through_record_chain
description: The routine walks a linked list of records, performs library steps on each record, and stores a result in a field of each one. It returns a record pointer when the list ends, or minus one if a step fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0004
name: open_libraries_and_resources
description: The routine calls a sequence of library and file routines and stores two resulting values in program data. The referenced text names the graphics and intuition libraries and the game's save and data folders.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0246
name: write_chunks_to_hard_drive
description: The routine creates a file on the hard drive from a given name and writes the supplied data in chunks of at most 32 kilobytes, closing the file afterwards. The referenced text reports that the file cannot be created and that the disk is full.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:033C
name: lock_or_create_floppy_directory
description: The routine tries to lock a game directory on the floppy drive and creates it when the lock fails. It then stores the value of a further call in program data, and the referenced text names the directory and the floppy device.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:040C
name: update_display_and_delay
description: When a display handle exists and a nonzero value is passed, the routine performs a series of library calls on the handle, writes a value, and waits for a fixed delay of 250 units. It makes a final set of library calls and returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0494
name: open_transfer_progress_window
description: The routine opens a display handle and draws a fixed set of library elements at coordinate-like arguments. The referenced text covers a transfer heading and a bytes-transferred label, and the routine returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0684
name: close_display_handle_if_open
description: If a stored handle is open, the routine calls a library routine on it and clears the stored value. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:06A0
name: draw_fixed_layout_elements
description: The routine makes a set of library calls on a stored handle using fixed coordinate-like arguments, then calls a further library routine with the passed value and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0724
name: advance_progress_counter_and_draw
description: The routine adds the passed value to a stored 32-bit counter, then makes library calls that draw a progress element using that counter and a fixed label position. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0786
name: pass_argument_along
description: The routine passes its single argument to another routine and returns.

name: init_disk_port_for_drive
description: The routine stores its two arguments, opens a disk port through library calls, and sets up the port with the trackdisk device driver. The referenced text covers failure to create the port and a drive that cannot be accessed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:08A4
name: store_request_fields
description: The routine stores its two arguments in two fields of a structure and clears a third field to zero. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:08BC
name: store_value_and_clear_field
description: The routine stores its argument in one field of a structure and clears a second field to zero. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:08CE
name: transfer_data_in_sectors
description: The routine copies a byte count into a buffer in pieces: first it fills the rest of the current 512-byte block, then whole blocks, updating the running position and offset fields as it goes. It makes a call for each piece.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:09BA
name: write_whole_sectors
description: The routine writes whole 512-byte blocks from the supplied buffer, computing the starting block from a stored offset. It advances the buffer and the counter for each block and returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:09E0
name: write_sector_sequence
description: The routine repeatedly calls another routine with a buffer pointer and a length of 512 bytes, advancing the pointer, block counter and running position until the remaining length is used up. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0A14
name: release_stored_device_handles
description: If the first stored value is zero, the routine releases a second stored value and buffer when that second value is nonzero. Otherwise it calls a library routine on the first stored value, and it returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0A50
name: seek_and_read_sector_block
description: The routine computes the position within the current 512-byte block. With a file handle it seeks to the block and reads one block into the buffer, and without one it updates the block number only when it has changed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0AEC
name: send_sector_read_request
description: The routine fills in a device request with a read command value, a length of 512 bytes, a buffer address and a byte offset equal to the block number times 512, then passes the request on. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0B16
name: send_sector_write_request
description: The routine fills in a device request with a write command value, a length of 512 bytes, a buffer address and a byte offset equal to the block number times 512, then passes the request on. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0B40
name: wait_for_data_disk_insertion
description: While a disk status byte holds a specific value, the routine repeatedly shows the request to insert the Battle Chess data disk and retries a library call until it succeeds. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0B9C
name: read_disk_block_with_restore
description: The routine saves a 52-byte request block, sets it up to read 4096 bytes, and performs the read. It restores the saved block afterwards and returns one only when the read reported no status error and a follow-up check returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0C68
name: send_device_command_code
description: The routine sets a device command value of a specific code on a request block and passes it on. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0C80

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:0DD2
name: initialize_game_session_state
description: The routine clears several state fields, copies two parameter values into the session, calls setup routines, and clears a flag at the end. It calls further routines when the second parameter is nonzero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:0E1A
name: poll_board_input_forever
description: The routine repeatedly waits for input codes and handles board clicks like its neighbours. It does not return on its own.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:0E1C
name: handle_board_click_code
description: When the input code is the board-click code, the routine selects the piece under the cursor or places the pending piece at that square, depending on whether a selection is pending. It returns to its caller afterwards.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:0E5A
name: pass_argument_to_display_call
description: The routine passes its argument to another routine and returns, with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:0E76
name: call_stored_handler_then_return
description: The routine calls a function pointer stored in program data with its argument, then calls another routine and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:0E92
name: map_screen_point_to_square
description: The routine converts a screen point into a board square by searching two sorted boundary tables of nine entries, one per axis. Points outside the board clear the stored square and call routines, and points inside store the square index.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:0FC6
name: clear_pending_selection_state
description: The routine records the current cursor and selection fields in saved slots, resets the cursor to empty, and clears the pending move fields. It first calls a routine on the pending piece when one is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1032
name: restore_saved_cursor_fields
description: The routine copies three saved values back into the cursor and selection fields and calls a routine with a fixed argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1070
name: read_text_entry_with_cursor
description: The routine sets up an edit buffer that shows a cursor underscore, then reads key codes through an input handler and accepts printable characters up to the given length. It returns the number of characters entered, or an error status.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:117C
name: prompt_think_time_minutes
description: The routine shows the prompt for the number of minutes to think, reads digits through the text entry routine, and converts them to a decimal number. It repeats until the value is nonzero and at most ten thousand, then returns it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:11F8
name: read_numeric_entry_limit
description: The routine converts a digit buffer into a decimal number, rejecting non-digit characters and values of ten thousand or more. It returns the number, or zero when the entry is invalid.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:123E
name: read_positive_number_entry
description: The routine reads an entry through the text reader, converts its digits to a decimal number, and returns it once it is nonzero and at most ten thousand. Until then it shows the entry prompt again.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1278
name: return_no_effect_stub
description: The routine has no body and returns with no effect.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1294
name: show_message_until_click
description: The routine marks a message state, measures the text length to size a centred box with a minimum width, and draws the box with the message. The referenced text asks the player to press the left button to continue, and the routine clears the state afterwards.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:13A2
name: wait_for_link_state_change
description: If either link slot reports status two, the routine marks the link active and loops, calling routines until the remote status changes or a flag is set. It then clears the link state.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:140E
name: clear_link_state_flags
description: The routine clears two link-state fields and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:141A
name: send_modem_command_line
description: The routine reads a short line of input and sends it through a stored output routine with a carriage return appended. A sequence of three plus signs takes the same send path.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:14D0
name: send_modem_echo_command
description: The routine sends a fixed four-byte modem command, the echo command, ending in a carriage return, through a stored output routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:14EE
name: show_opponent_quit_message
description: The routine passes a fixed message to a stored routine, and the referenced text says that the opponent has just quit. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:151E
name: read_link_flag_or_status
description: If the link slot reports status two, the routine waits until a received flag is set and then returns its value and clears it. Otherwise it draws a fixed status panel and resets its state fields.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1548
name: take_received_flag
description: The routine returns the received flag byte and clears it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1558
name: draw_link_status_panel
description: The routine draws a fixed panel of boxes around a text region, then sets a display state flag and returns a byte value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1560
name: draw_link_status_panel_return
description: The routine draws the same fixed panel of boxes around a text region as its neighbour and returns a byte value after setting the display state flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:156E
name: choose_promotion_piece
description: The routine draws a dialogue asking which piece a pawn should promote to, waits for a choice among the piece options, and returns its code. The referenced text is the promotion prompt.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:16B0
name: wait_for_click_in_region
description: The routine loops on input codes until the stored cursor position lies within a fixed rectangle, then returns the entry from a lookup table at the matching column index. It clears the active flag before returning.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1722
name: draw_bevelled_frame
description: The routine draws a text label and then a frame made of stepped coordinate lines, stepping thirty times to build the border. It takes four coordinates and a label parameter and returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:17D2
name: update_state_indicator_if_changed
description: When the passed state differs from the stored one, the routine stores the new state and draws the matching indicator, using different offsets when the state is four. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:183E
name: setup_display_buffer_pointers
description: The routine assigns a pointer to a region and computes several sub-buffer pointers at fixed offsets, stepping through four entries whose sizes come from a table. It then stores further pointers and makes calls to set up the display.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1A20
name: assign_buffer_pointer_fields
description: The routine stores pointers to two buffers and to offsets derived from them in fixed fields of the program state, adding fixed sizes of 264 and 60 bytes. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1A70
name: initialize_board_tables
description: The routine clears a six-entry table and sets an eight-entry table to the fill value, then calls routines to set up the display and copy stored data. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1B46
name: setup_table_pointers
description: The routine calls library routines to open a stored resource, sets five table pointers at fixed offsets, and makes several setup calls before a final library call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1BCE
name: xor_shifted_data_block
description: The routine calls a library routine with a 5120-byte size, then XORs a 39960-byte region with the same region shifted forward by 40 bytes. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1C3C
name: save_display_state_fields
description: The routine copies several configuration fields and pointers into a backup area of the program state. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1C6E
name: restore_display_state_fields
description: The routine copies the backup area fields back into the active configuration fields and pointers. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1CA0
name: save_alternate_state_fields
description: The routine copies a different set of active fields and a pointer into a second backup area. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1CD2
name: return_unreached_stub
description: The routine is an empty body that returns immediately.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1D0C
name: register_table_entries_with_sizes
description: The routine walks a null-terminated list of pointers and records each one in a table entry together with a running address. It then calls a routine with a size computed from two stored byte fields multiplied by five and returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:1E60
name: process_indexed_table_entry
description: The routine looks up an indexed entry in two stored tables, calls library routines with those entries, and then processes a byte sequence from the source into the target area. It loops over the data and returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:21F6
name: reset_indexed_slot_pointers
description: The routine clears a flag byte for an indexed slot, reads the slot's two pointer fields and calls a library routine with them, then resets those fields to zero. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:22BC
name: release_indexed_slot_pointers
description: The routine reads the two pointer fields of an indexed slot, calls a library routine, and clears those fields, then continues with a loop that adjusts stored values for the slot. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:2412
name: subtract_twice_across_span
description: The routine walks two pointer lists, copying a short value and writing each entry of the second list minus twice a stored delta into the first, until the count runs out. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:243A
name: adjust_range_entries
description: The routine subtracts twice a stored delta from each entry in a range of a table, bounded by a stored limit, and then updates the stored endpoints. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:245E
name: shift_table_range_down
description: The routine subtracts a stored value from each entry in a table from a starting index up to a limit, then copies the range endpoints and checks the result of a library call. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:24D6
name: reduce_count_by_span
description: The routine subtracts the difference between two stored endpoint values from a stored count field and returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:24FE
name: register_table_entry_with_buffer
description: The routine marks an indexed slot as active and stores two pointers, a count and a buffer pointer from the stored state. It calls a library routine with a 5120-byte size and copies data into the buffer, returning no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:25E6
name: mark_slot_and_advance_pointer
description: The routine marks an indexed slot as active, stores the current data pointer in it, calls a library routine on a stored handle, and advances the data pointer by an even-aligned size. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:2654
name: compute_slot_space_budget
description: The routine computes the free space as a stored limit minus the used span, sums the sizes of active slots, and adjusts slot positions to fit the remaining space. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:2766
name: mark_pending_slots_from_list
description: The routine walks a terminated byte list, flagging each entry whose high bit is set in a table, then picks pending entries to process until the count is reached. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:27AE
name: select_smallest_pending_slot
description: The routine loops over six slots and picks the one that is marked as not yet placed and has the smallest size, then processes that slot until the byte budget is used up. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:2844
name: check_slot_space_or_fail
description: The routine computes the remaining space and calls a routine on each slot that is not yet placed. The referenced text reports an error that there is not enough memory when the space is insufficient.
